# Task Content Fidelity

## 1. Required Context Rows Carry Measured Values

Every Required Context row states a measured size, not an estimate.

## 2. Shared Context

When several task files in one sprint read the same file, the shared-context rule
applies: one source of truth per sprint, restated identically in every task file.

## 3. Freshness

A measurement older than the last edit to its subject is stale.

## 4. Large-File Ladder

Page a file that exceeds the one-read token cap; never claim a partial read as whole.

## 5. Cross-References

The shared-context rule above is the canonical statement; do not restate it elsewhere.
